title: Forecrew test matrix
description: Schema of .forecrew/matrix.yaml, written by the test architect and approved with the test plan (test_plan_approval gate). The axes span cells (one value per axis); exclude removes cells, include adds them; each cell runs the suites that apply to it as command jobs in the environment its first matching rule names. internal/testsys validates it (this schema, then cross-references: axes, values and environment names).

value.description: Axis value. Numbers and booleans are read as the text written, so 1.20 stays "1.20".

cell.description: Partial cell: axis -> value. A cell matches when it has every listed value.

glob.description: Doublestar glob relative to the repo root (or to the suite's working directory when the job sets one).

command.description: argv list run without a shell, or a string run with sh -c (cmd /c on Windows). It must write JUnit XML to reports.

reports.description: JUnit XML files the command writes. A suite with no report after the run is errored.

artifacts.description: Other files to keep as evidence (logs, screenshots, coverage).

required.description: Whether a failure of this suite in a required cell blocks the merge. Default true.

quirks.description: Platform-behaviour suite (paths, line endings, locale, time zones), runnable on its own with scope quirks. Default false.

axes.description: Limits the suite to cells whose values are listed here, per axis. Absent: every cell.
Axis name -> values. Cells are every combination. Absent or empty: one cell with no axes.

exclude.description: Partial cells removed from the combinations.

include.description: Cells added after exclude; they may use values the axes do not list. Every axis must be given.

environments.description: Rules mapping a cell to an environment (.forecrew/environments/<environment>.yaml); the first rule whose match the cell has wins. A cell no rule matches is an error.

required.description: Partial cells that must pass to merge. Absent: every cell is required.
